cards.b: Ink on the raised surface of a block, e.g. lino or woodcut; carved areas stay white.
One-off print from ink or paint on a smooth plate.
Print from a plate built up from textured materials, sealed before inking.
A set of identical prints from one plate.
Lining up each layer or colour in a multi-layer print.
One block carved more between colour layers; Picasso used it.
Japanese woodblock artist; The Great Wave off Kanagawa, c. 1831, with flat colour and outline.
Sticking paper, photographs, fabric or other flat materials onto a surface.
Collage made from photographs, e.g. Hannah Höch.
Cubist pasted paper, first by Braque and Picasso around 1912.
Shapes cut from gouache-painted paper, e.g. The Snail, 1953.
Using more than one medium or process in one piece, each chosen for a reason.
Building an image in layers; allow drying and use transparent layers to show beneath.
Cut away from your body and hands; use a bench hook or cutting mat.

gaps.s: A print made from the raised surface of a carved block is a ___ print.
A one-off print is called a ___.
Lining up layers in a multi-layer print is called ___.
Collage made of photographs is called ___.
A work made by arranging found three-dimensional objects is an ___.
Kurt Schwitters made collages he called ___.
A group of identical prints from the same plate is an ___.

short.q: Describe how to make a lino print.
short.model: Draw the design in reverse on the block, carve away the areas that should stay white, roll ink on the surface, press paper onto it and peel off the print.

short.q: Give two safety rules for lino cutting.
short.model: Cut away from your body and hand, and use a bench hook or cutting mat.

short.q: Name one collage artist and describe their work.
short.model: Hannah Höch cut up magazine photographs to make Dada photomontages that questioned society.

short.q: Why combine materials in mixed media?
short.model: Each material adds a quality, such as transparent tissue for memory or sand for rough texture, so the piece communicates the idea more strongly.

short.q: Why is a print test useful for AO2?
short.model: You can compare inks, pressures and colours, select the best version and explain why, which shows exploring and selecting.
